recipe.name: StudyB_CoC_Co42s_C108s_N20_2mT
recipe.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Recipe>
	<Description type="">
		<Title></Title>
		<Author></Author>
		<Created>2026-10-14</Created>
		<Modified>2026-10-14</Modified>
		<Notes></Notes>
	</Description>
	<Parameters>
		<Group name="Deposition Conditions">
			<Param name="P" caption="Working pressure" unit="mTorr" type="float">2.00mT</Param>
			<Param name="Pbase" caption="Release pressure" unit="mTorr" type="float">0mT</Param>
			<Param name="ArFlow" caption="Ar flow per line" unit="sccm" type="float">20</Param>
			<Param name="N" caption="Periods" unit="N" type="float">20</Param>
		</Group>
		<Group name="Layer Co">
			<Param name="currentCo" caption="Current" unit="mA" type="float">50</Param>
			<Param name="freqCo" caption="Pulse frequency" unit="kHz" type="float">40</Param>
			<Param name="dutyCo" caption="Duty cycle" unit="%" type="float">70</Param>
			<Param name="timeCo" caption="Time per layer" unit="sec" type="float">42.0</Param>
		</Group>
		<Group name="Layer C">
			<Param name="currentC" caption="Current" unit="mA" type="float">300</Param>
			<Param name="freqC" caption="Pulse frequency" unit="kHz" type="float">50</Param>
			<Param name="dutyC" caption="Duty cycle" unit="%" type="float">60</Param>
			<Param name="timeC" caption="Time per layer" unit="sec" type="float">108.0</Param>
		</Group>
	</Parameters>
	<Script># Repeat of P2-05 (ELN project 33, item 1397) for demonstration study B, without its raised-pressure C strike: glass / [Co / C] x N, C on top
power G3F_C off
power G3F_B off
shutter Home
holder Home
valve V1 close
valve V4 close
valve V5 close
valve VI close
mfc N21 0
mfc N22 0
valve V2 open
valve V6 open
valve M1 open
valve V3 open
valve M2 open
mfc Ar1 ArFlow
mfc Ar2 ArFlow
pwait P 300
set G3F_C Current currentCo
set G3F_C Frequency freqCo
set G3F_C DutyCycle dutyCo
shutter Co
power G3F_C on
delay 120s
set G3F_B Current currentC
set G3F_B Frequency freqC
set G3F_B DutyCycle dutyC
shutter C
power G3F_B on
delay 60s
delay 120s
loop N
deposit Co timeCo Home
deposit C timeC Home
endloop
holder Home
power G3F_C off
power G3F_B off
shutter Home
mfc Ar1 0
mfc Ar2 0
valve M1 close
valve M2 close
valve V6 close
valve V2 close
valve V3 close
pwait Pbase 30</Script>
</Recipe>
